defects.what: "Guwahati" in the city pill renders in the same mid-grey as a placeholder would, on the #F4F4F2 tinted pill — estimated contrast roughly 3.2–3.6:1, below the 4.5:1 AA floor for tinted backgrounds (law 5), and it fails law 2/honesty: a confirmed choice should not visually read as unfilled placeholder text.
defects.where: City field pill, above the Get started button

measured_notes: City pill text "Guwahati": mid-grey (~#8a8a8a-ish) on soft grey (#F4F4F2) — estimated ~3.3:1, under 4.5:1.
"Get started" pill: white on near-black (~#111) — comfortably >4.5:1; height ~44–48px, width full minus 16px gutters; target OK.
City pill height ~44px, full-width with consistent ~16px gutters — touch target OK.
Skip label top-right: small grey text (~14px), estimated contrast ~3.5:1 on white — under AA for body-size text.
No truncation/ellipsis seen on any text; headline "Turn confirmed" and body copy fully wrap on two/three lines.
Hierarchy reads correctly: headline first, then illustration, then form controls; no layout shift or crowding between the Guwahati pill and Get started pill — ~12px gap visible.
non_blocking_notes: Dark pill CTA conflicts with the stated single teal accent law — black is used as the accent here while teal appears only in the illustration dot/squiggle; cosmetic inconsistency worth logging.
Progress dots: first two light grey, third black — selected state via grey/black rather than teal, same accent-consistency note.
Skip button looks slightly under 44px tall as a text-only target (~14–18px hit area visually); flagging as observation since exact padding is not measurable from the screenshot.
one_line: Passes on layout, targets, and hierarchy, but the confirmed "Guwahati" value sits at roughly AA-failing grey-on-tint contrast and reads like a placeholder rather than a committed choice — fix the text color before ship.
